terms.gloss: a break, a rest from work
evidence: Quint. 1.3.8: danda est tamen omnibus aliqua remissiō
Tac. Dial. 28.6: remissiōnēs etiam lūsūsque puerōrum
terms.comment: A slackening, and so a rest from work: Quintilian’s word for the break that every pupil must be given.

sources: Lewis & Short: pausa · Lewis & Short: remissio
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, supplied PDF (printed page numbers): p. 31.
Quintilian checked against the Perseus Latin texts (9 November 2026); Tacitus from the Latinitas loci collection (loci-tacitus).

phrases.latin: danda est tamen omnibus aliqua remissiō; nōn sōlum quia nūlla rēs est, quae perferre possit continuum labōrem
phrases.english: Still, everyone must be given some break; not only because nothing can bear unbroken work
